description.value: Sunflower Lodge is a farm-to-table restaurant housed in a hand-built log cabin within Fraser River Heritage Park, offering sweeping Fraser River and mountain views from both a 44-seat interior and a 48-seat patio. The kitchen draws from the owners' Maple Ridge farm, where over 200 varieties of certified organic fruits, vegetables, and herbs are grown using regenerative no-till methods, resulting in a hyper-seasonal menu that changes with what is freshest. BC beers, ciders, and wines round out the drinks list, with all beer and cider selections rotating seasonally.
